census.note: inventoried, not executed: priced beyond an in-session build under the PRESS-010 subprocess-per-call model; see economics.projection below

corpus: multi-repo ecosystem: mncs-index + locally available mncs-* repos
corpus_rule: tier=family: up to max_files_per_repo=2 alphabetically-first **/*.mncs per repo (excluding .git/target/caches/build dirs and symlinks), each at most per_file_bytes=2048 bytes (0 = uncapped)

economics.model: one mncs execute subprocess per kernel call (bridge.stats.calls); pure-function memoization only

projection.note: linear projection of the measured calls/KB rate to census bytes; vocabulary caches make this an upper bound, subprocess contention makes wall time superlinear — the census stays inventoried, not executed

note: Rich canonical-v2 snapshots: every verdict (digests, kinds, tokens, declarations, headings, links, PRESS/RFC shapes, traversal admission) is a real MNCS kernel call; the host moves bytes, bounds queues, and sorts by the specified key. One process, one shared Kernels handle (pure memoization, as in tests): later worker counts re-verify hash convergence. Per-run call counts are deltas off the shared bridge counter; hashes are canonical.

tiers.census: every *.mncs under each sibling mncs-* repo (excluding SKIP_DIRS/symlinks); inventoried, not executed
tiers.family: up to max_files_per_repo alphabetically-first *.mncs per repo, each at most per_file_bytes bytes; the executed scale corpus
tiers.mutation: five-class edit batch (change/add/remove/rename/RFC+pressure) on a staged corpus; incremental == rebuild incl. rich+invalidation
